name: HORIZONTAL AUTOCLAVE
desc: Triple-Walled Cylindrical Horizontal Autoclave engineered for high-capacity sterilization and disinfection of medical instruments. Features a 150-liter inner chamber, radial locking door, inbuilt boiler with low-water cut-off, and an advanced PID microprocessor controller with USB logging.
features: 121°C to 135°C highly regulated sterilization footprint at 15-32 PSI
Triple-Walled Cylindrical Design with full Argon Welding
Advanced Microprocessor-Based PID Controller with 5-Inch Touchscreen
Inbuilt Boiler Assembly with low-water cut-off and safety valves
Integrated USB data port interface with built-in Print Records Facility

specifications.Chamber Orientation / Shape: Cylindrical Design Type with stable heavy-duty chrome-plated MS stand
specifications.Internal Chamber Material: High-Grade Stainless Steel (SS 304 / SS 316) with full Argon Welding
specifications.Finishing Treatment: Mirror-finished inner and external surfaces for easy decontamination
specifications.Door Operation Mechanism: Single Door equipped with heavy-duty Radial Locking safety device
specifications.Door Construction Build: Robust Chrome-Plated Mild Steel (MS) structure with silicon gasket sealing
specifications.Working Pressure Scale: 15 to 32 PSI optimized pressure control range
specifications.Hydraulic Safety Test: Minimum hydraulic pressure tested up to 40 PSI for structural integrity
specifications.Primary Heating Source: High-Efficiency Immersion Heaters (Nickel Chromium Plated Copper Tubes)
specifications.Inbuilt Boiler Assembly: Equipped with water inlet/outlet valves, water level glass window, and safety valve
specifications.Controller Architecture: Advanced Microprocessor-Based PID Temperature and Pressure Controller
specifications.Display Interface Screen: Premium 5-Inch or larger high-visibility Digital LCD/LED/TFT Display
specifications.Pressure Release Automation: Automated auto-release of pressure through solenoid / pneumatic valves
specifications.Manual Safety Overrides: Independent manual pressure release valves for both chamber and jacket
specifications.Secondary Safety Overrides: Spring-loaded safety valves for excess pressure inside jacket and steam generator
specifications.Post-Process Features: Integrated Multiport Valve with active provision for complete Vacuum Drying
specifications.Chamber Condensate Line: Heavy-duty line fitted with high-efficiency steam trap and check valve
specifications.System Security Controls: Intelligent Low Water Cut-Off mechanism to prevent heater burnout
specifications.Data Auditing Interfaces: Integrated USB data port interface with built-in Print Records Facility
specifications.Power Supply Requirements: 220V Single Phase / 440V Three Phase, 50-60 Hz Industrial Link
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty on complete system
